items.title: Dryer purge valve not seating — Compressor stays loaded and does not reach cut-out
items.cause: The purge valve of the desiccant dryer does not close between changeovers, so part of the delivered air escapes at the purge silencer instead of reaching the plant.
checks: Listen at the purge silencer while the unit is loaded; a steady discharge between tower changeovers points at the valve.
Watch dryer purge pressure through a complete changeover and check whether it falls back to its resting value.
Isolate the dryer and see whether the unit reaches its cut-out pressure again.
items.remedy: Overhaul or replace the purge valve and its pilot line, then repeat the changeover test and confirm that the purge pressure returns to its resting value between towers.

manual_ref.title: Compressor stays loaded and does not reach cut-out

evidence.observation: The unit has been loaded without reaching cut-out for about an hour.
Dryer purge pressure has stayed far above its resting value between changeovers.
